name: Hybrid DeltaNet + MHA
tagline: DeltaNet everywhere except two full-attention layers.
description: The DeltaNet global-hybrid layout: full causal multi-head attention at layers 2 and 13 of 24, DeltaNet in the other 22 layers. DeltaNet reuses the linear family's projections, causal convolution, beta, q/k normalization and output normalization, trained with FLA's chunked delta rule. Native MHA, ReLU² FFN, smear, backout and residual/x0 coefficients are retained.
paperTitle: Parallelizing Linear Transformers with the Delta Rule over Sequence Length
mechanism: 24 layers: full causal MHA at layers 2 and 13, DeltaNet elsewhere
DeltaNet with chunked delta-rule training; linear state resets at packed rows
FFN 6400; one joint next-token stage, no auxiliary loss
limitations: The native-MHA adaptation of the paper's global hybrid, not its separate local-MQA variant. Registered and admitted within the shared budget; no formal result is published yet. Parameters, memory and speed are outcomes, not controls.
